The first public release of Pimento: bulk-activate your Azure PIM roles from a native Mac app
or the `pimento` command line, as you, with your existing Azure CLI session.

## Download

**Mac app** (macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon and Intel):
**[Download Pimento.dmg](https://github.com/Melvin2306/pimento/releases/latest/download/Pimento.dmg)**

1. Open `Pimento.dmg` and drag **Pimento** onto **Applications**.
2. Open Pimento from Applications. The first time, macOS blocks it: Pimento is a free
   open-source app that is not notarized by Apple (that needs a paid developer account). To allow
   it once:
   - **macOS 15 Sequoia and later**: click **Done**, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**,
     scroll down to *"Pimento" was blocked…* and click **Open Anyway**, then **Open Anyway** again.
   - **macOS 14 Sonoma**: right-click (or Control-click) Pimento, choose **Open**, then **Open**.
3. Sign in with the Azure CLI (`az login`) or Pimento's own sign-in. To look around first:
   **Pimento › Demo Mode** (synthetic data, nothing sent anywhere).

The app has the command-line tool inside: **Pimento › Install Command Line Tool…**

**Command-line tool only** (macOS, Linux, Windows):

```sh
# macOS and Linux: installs to ~/.local/bin, no sudo
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Melvin2306/pimento/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

```powershell
# Windows (PowerShell): installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Pimento and adds it to your PATH
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Melvin2306/pimento/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

The installers check the download's SHA-256 against `SHA256SUMS.txt` (and its build attestation
when the GitHub CLI is installed and signed in). Or download an archive below:

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Pimento.dmg` | the Mac app, with the CLI inside |
| `Pimento.zip` | the same app as a zip |
| `pimento-cli-macos.tar.gz` | the CLI for macOS (universal) |
| `pimento-cli-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | the CLI for Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, libcurl) |
| `pimento-cli-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | the CLI for Linux arm64 (glibc 2.35+, libcurl) |
| `pimento-cli-windows-x86_64.zip` | the CLI for Windows 10/11 (needs the Visual C++ Redistributable) |

Every file is attached twice: under the stable name above (for `releases/latest/download/` links)
and with the version in its name (`Pimento-0.1.0.dmg`, `pimento-cli-0.1.0-macos.tar.gz`, …).
The contents are identical.

## Verify

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing      # macOS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt --ignore-missing          # Linux
gh attestation verify Pimento.dmg --repo Melvin2306/pimento   # built by this repository's release workflow
```

On Windows: `Get-FileHash pimento-cli-windows-x86_64.zip` and compare with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Highlights

- **Bulk activation**: every eligible Azure resource role on one screen; pick the ones you need,
  give one justification, activate them in parallel, with a per-row result.
- **Each role's policy respected**: durations are capped at the role's maximum; ticket and
  approval requirements are shown before anything is sent; Owner roles ask first.
- **Presets**, **scheduled activations**, **end early / renew**, **approvals** (as requester and
  approver), and a searchable **history** of everything Pimento sent.
- **Menu bar** countdown with Renew and End Now, and expiry reminders.
- **`pimento` CLI** on macOS, Linux and Windows: the same features, JSON output, exit codes, shell
  completions.
- **Pimento sign-in** (optional): sign in without the Azure CLI, with your own app registration.
- **Demo mode**: every feature against a simulated Azure with synthetic data, offline.
- No client secret or service principal, no third-party dependencies, no telemetry. Access
  tokens stay in memory and go only to `management.azure.com`.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Melvin2306/pimento/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
